svg.title: Read every page, or follow three pointers
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Read every page, or follow three pointers” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. On the left, a sequential scan drawn as seventy-two heap pages all swept, removing 333,332 rows per worker in 86.8 milliseconds. On the right, a B-tree with the descent path from root through one internal node to one leaf traced in bold with numbered steps, reaching the row in 0.033 milliseconds, with 1970x written between them. Below, a composite index on (customer_id, placed_at) is drawn as sorted keys grouped by customer, serving a leftmost-prefix query in 0.512 ms while a second-column-only predicate falls back to a 116.6 ms scan.
svg.text: Read every page, or follow three pointers
draw it from memory, then compare
